serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I’m not sure if everything you said is right, but 1200$ is a lot of money…
Landlord: Heh, I’m glad that I got this stupid idea out of your head. Now you can’t say I never did anything for you!
You: Thanks I guess…
Landlord: Don’t worry, when I was your age I had some stupid ideas too, but I learned from my mistakes. This apartment building had a lot of occupants and after some time they all seem the same to me.
Landlord: These things I saw while being a landlord here… {{wi}}Most people wouldn’t believe it…
Landlord: It changes a man… {{wi}}It really does…{{wi}} Work of animals disguised as men…{{wi}} Did they do this for revenge? {{wi}}Did they really hate me that much? {{wi}}Or maybe they did it just for their sick, twisted pleasure? 
Landlord: I can’t sleep at night… {{wi}}Asking these questions over and over…{{wi}} But in the end…{{wi}} no one answers…
H-he’s kinda scaring me right now… {{wi}}M-mom...
You:W-what did they do? 
Landlord: Do you really want to know?
